feeds.title: Above Standard Poodles Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is where you can get to know the puppies we have available. You'll be able to see pictures, learn about their personalities, and find all the details on how old they are, when they're ready to come home to you etc. We raise our wonderful Poodles in the middle of the 'country' in Tennessee.

feeds.title: Standard Poodles Of Forest Lakes Blog
feeds.description: Get to know about our litters, show dogs and more. We are focused on producing quality Standard Poodles in our home

feeds.title: Poodle Blogger
feeds.description: I'm talking about all Poodles--big curly dogs, energetic water dogs, little lap dogs, flying leap agility dogs, groomed-up-to-look-ridiculous show dogs and just plain simple Poodle dogs. If it is Poodle-ly, it is, in my book, fascinating. Melanie has four decades of experience as a dog trainer, and over three decades of experience as a canine behavioral consultant.

feeds.title: Poodles and Bob Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about poodles, behavior training tips and more! Poodles and Bob has been in business on The Outer Banks since May 2018. The 'original' crew was Scout, a brown and white, fancy, parti poodle and Sailor 'Bob', a very hard-headed, but remarkably handsome chocolate English Lab.

feeds.title: Winters Wind Standard Poodles Blog
feeds.description: Explore Stories about Standard Poodles and the enjoyment we have with our dogs. We are serious breeders, not 'Hobby Breeders or breeders that do this for fun'; it is a serious decision to breed animals.

feeds.title: Simply Poodles Blog
feeds.description: My name is Patrick and I love Poodles. We got our first Poodle in the spring of 2018 and have loved having a Poodle ever since. I created this website to share everything I learn about Poodles.

feeds.title: Galavanting Poodles Blog
feeds.description: Find articles and helpful information about raising poodles and hiking, playing, and training poodles. Puppy announcements, grooming tips and what life is like with poodles in Alaska are also topics included in the poodle blog. Galavanting Poodles is home to Alaska's adventure poodles and AKC show standard poodles.
